verified_behavior: Generated resume and cover-letter text is compared to deterministic approved-fact templates before staged revisions are published; exact comparison blocks unapproved organization, employer, institution, credential, degree and other text mutations.
Novel dates and numeric tokens in generated factual content are rejected with UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM before document activation.

Validated revisions and DOCUMENTS_VALIDATED audit events persist typed fact IDs, protected-field categories, preservation decisions and date/numeric token counts without duplicating claim text, token values or reversible hashes.
Deterministic template and explicit user fact selection control keep/drop decisions; no LLM relevance scorer or provider is called.
Adversarial failures preserve existing document bytes and history; equal fact IDs from distinct profiles do not merge profile documents or claim context.
limitations: The no-AI architecture has no LLM relevance scorer; separating a future scorer from deterministic keep/drop is enforced by the current explicit selection boundary, while paid/provider-backed scoring remains unavailable and NOT_RUN.
The issue-level tests use synthetic SQLite and local browser harnesses; production PostgreSQL/Docker deployment and hosted checks were NOT_RUN under user policy.
Full original requirements and release acceptance remain PARTIAL; this PASS applies only to MJ-REF-010 issue acceptance.
The local npm Node-engine mismatch and high-severity advisory are recorded; dependency files were not changed.
